units.source_text: 空蝉回想自身境遇，觉得和源氏公子太不相称，心中不免惭愧。

en.t: Utsusemi thought back on her own circumstances and felt that she was far too ill matched with Prince Genji, so she could not help feeling ashamed.

units.source_text: 源氏公子对她如此热爱，她并不觉得欢喜。

en.t: Although Prince Genji loved her so deeply, she did not feel happy about it.

units.source_text: 她心中只是想着平日所讨厌的丈夫伊豫介：

en.t: In her heart she thought only of Iyo no Suke, the husband she usually disliked:
Could he have dreamed of what happened to me last night?
Thinking of this, she was overcome with fear.
